title: Claude Code runner errors
description: The Claude Code runner's own error codes, beyond the runner contract's. They fill the contract's runnerErrors extension point. Each refuses run/start, so no run starts.

oneOf.description: The run/start options hold a key the runner doesn't define.
An option's value has the wrong shape. The fix names what is valid.
No claude program is on the PATH the runner was given.

path.description: The PATH searched. Absent when the runner was given no PATH.

oneOf.description: The runner couldn't prepare the run, such as making its private directory.

where.description: Where the problem is, such as options.permissionMode, or the directory that couldn't be made.
